resolution_notes: example: INCORRECT. The original request omitted the required Accept-Version header. Current official documentation requires Accept-Version: v1 on every request, and its authentication example also includes Accept: application/json. The response schema uses orig_iata rather than origin. Evidence: https://fr24api.flightradar24.com/docs/endpoints/overview and https://fr24api.flightradar24.com/docs/authentication
